name: emulo
title_zh: 跨Agent迁移技能时先问一句你本地有没有这段历史
tagline_zh: 换到新Agent环境，技能库跟着断代？它从你真实编码会话里重挖Emulo，不靠云端同步，不靠手工搬运，装一次就续上。
tagline_en: Switching agents and losing your skill state? It rebuilds Emulo from real local session logs—no cloud, no manual.
desc_en: Use when the user explicitly asks to run, set up, update, re-mine, or deepen Emulo from real local AI coding-session history and native emulo:mine is not available. This is the cross-agent skills.sh bootstrap, not the native namespaced plugin.
why_zh: 别的迁移靠文件拷贝，它靠本地会话历史反推技能状态，机制上更像考古而非搬运，适合对技能来源有洁癖的人。
why_en: Others copy files; this digs through session history to reconstruct skill state. Archaeology over transfer—for those who want.
limit_zh: 只认本地真实编码会话记录，且仅当emulo:mine原生插件不可用时才启动；不处理云端历史，不生成新技能。
limit_en: Only works with local real coding-session logs, and only when native emulo:mine is absent. No cloud history, no new skill generation, just re-mining.
title_en: Re-mine Emulo from your local coding history when native.
